## #3 — jollyjo — 2008-04-10
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/2627/post-20243>

Hi, i am new at Cheetah.
How i install the scripts?

## #4 — frank beckmann — 2008-04-10
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/2627/post-20245>

Hi and welcome.
Find: /Users//Library/Application Support/scripts=Polygonobj;Splineobj;Tag;Tool;Macro
Find the related folders in the sampler folder and distribute them to the related folders.
Close and start Cheetah3d. You will find the scripts now at the main menu under "Tools->scripts" and so on.

With kindest regards
Frank

PS: hairball. You could provide a simple "How-To-Install) with your sampler.
